changelog:
Initial release of the Build Operations FAQ Page skill.

- Enables generation of customer-facing answers for common business operations questions.
- Designed for use by operators, agencies, and business teams creating FAQ content.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow for clarifying requirements and refining outputs.
- Optimized for SEO with keywords like "FAQ generator AI" and "ops workflow automation".
- Utilizes chat and web search APIs to support answer generation.
summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common operations questions. Use when working on FAQ content for operators, agencies, business teams.
